title: sill configuration
description: Configuration for sill, the config-file schema validator.

root.description: Reserved: stop the upward config search at this directory.

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from discovery.

schemas.description: Ordered glob→schema mappings; first match wins. Beats catalogs, loses to an inline $schema reference.

files.description: Glob(s) relative to the repo root; bare filenames match at any depth.

schema.description: Schema URL, or a path relative to this config file.

registries.description: Extra SchemaStore-format catalog URLs, consulted before SchemaStore itself.

catalog.description: Consult the SchemaStore catalog for files with no other association.

vendor.description: Hermetic mode: resolve remote schemas from a vendored directory maintained by `sill vendor`.

dir.description: Directory holding manifest.json and vendored schema copies.
